subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Gestation and Forty Weeks
description: Learn Gestation and Forty Weeks in one minute.

hook.text: Human pregnancy lasts approximately forty weeks. Life itself begins after a forty-count.

buildup.text: Ancient cultures noticed this. The connection between forty and new life reinforced the number's sacredness.

discovery.text: In many traditions, a mother is secluded for forty days after birth. Mother and child undergo parallel transformations.

twist.text: The Bible's forty overlaps with biological forty. Whether by design or observation, nature and scripture rhyme.

climax.text: Forty marks transitions: birth, death, revelation, renewal. It's the gap between who you were and who you'll become.

punchline.text: Forty weeks to be born. Forty days to transform.

quiz.question: How long is a typical human pregnancy?
